questions.question: Why did the Jews ask Pilate to have the legs of the men being crucified broken?

answers.text: So the bodies would not stay up on the Sabbath
So the soldiers could leave before dark
So the crowd would stop gathering there

questions.question: Why did the soldiers not break the legs of Jesus on the cross?
Pilate refused to let Joseph of Arimathea take away the body of Jesus. True or false?
After Jesus died on the cross, where was His body laid?

answers.text: In a new tomb in a garden
In the tomb where Lazarus was buried
In a cave where the disciples hid
